name: Issues
description: Issues capabilities. Includes Bulk Mutate an Organization's Issues, Bulk Remove an Organization's Issues, Create a new issue in the external provider (such as a Jira ticket or GitHub issue) and link it to the given Sentry issue, Link an issue that already exists in the external provider (such as a Jira ticket or GitHub issue) to the given Sentry issue, List a Tag's Values for an Issue, List an Issue's Events, List an Issue's Hashes, List an Issue's Tracker Integrations and Links, and 12 more.
